seoTitle.en: DISC Test: 24 Questions, Scoring and Full Results

introduction.zh: DISC是一组描述行为风格的框架，常用D（Dominance，主导）、I（Influence，影响）、S（Steadiness，稳定）与C（Conscientiousness，审慎）组织对行动、互动、支持与标准的讨论。其理论源流通常追溯到Marston在1928年的著作；今天使用的题本、计分与报告则由不同开发者分别建立。[1] 本页是费马原创的24题强迫选择式自报问卷：四个方向分别称为“推进处理、表达带动、稳定支持、规范核对”，用于整理本次情境中的相对选择。它适合希望回看日常协作与沟通习惯的读者。完成后可查看四项原始计数、所有最高并列、对应完整说明及两种泰国四动物命名对照；下面也可先阅读全部15种单项或并列指南。
introduction.en: DISC is a family of behavioral-style frameworks using D (Dominance), I (Influence), S (Steadiness) and C (Conscientiousness) to organize discussion of action, interaction, support and standards. Its theoretical roots are commonly traced to Marston’s 1928 work; later developers created distinct questionnaires, scoring methods and reports.[1] This page is FermatMind’s original 24-item forced-choice self-report. Its four directions—moving things forward, engaging through expression, steady support, and standards and checks—summarize relative choices in these situations. It is intended for readers reflecting on everyday collaboration and communication. The output includes four raw counts, every highest-count tie, complete explanations and two Thai Four Animals naming comparisons. All 15 single-direction or tied guides are also available to read before taking the test.

title.zh: D·推进处理
title.en: D · Moving things forward

summary.zh: 本次比较中，推进处理的选项被选得最多。可以把它当作一个观察问题：面对模糊任务，你是否常先问要完成什么、谁来做、什么时候回看？这不说明你天生适合领导，也不能推出你在所有场合都果断。
summary.en: Moving-forward options received your highest count in this attempt. A useful question is whether you first clarify the outcome, owner and review time when a task is vague. This does not establish leadership suitability or decisiveness in every setting.

scoreReading.zh: 怎么算分：每道题都是两个方向二选一，选中的方向得 1 次；四个方向各出场 12 次。本次 D·推进处理次数最多。这个数字只在这 24 题内部成立，不是人群百分位，不是准确率，也跟浓度无关。
scoreReading.en: How scoring works: each question asks you to choose between two directions, and the selected direction gains 1 count. Each of the four directions appears 12 times. D, moving things forward, had the highest count this time. This number applies only within these 24 questions; it is not a population percentile, an accuracy rate or a concentration.

title.zh: 先读清这次计数
title.en: Read the counts before the description

paragraphs.zh: 24题每题在两个方向中选一项，所选方向加1；四个计数合计24，每个方向有12次被选机会。次数比较的是本题组中的相对选择，不是能力、人格浓度或人群百分位。较少选择也不表示缺少某种品质。
paragraphs.en: Across 24 paired questions, each selection adds 1 to one direction. The four counts sum to 24, and each direction has 12 opportunities to be selected. Counts compare choices within this question set, rather than ability, personality concentration or population percentile. Fewer selections do not establish an absent quality.

paragraphs.zh: 最高只表示比本次其余三个计数大；领先1次与领先多次不能直接解释为类型稳定程度。本站未建立“接近就算混合型”的阈值，也不把计数转换成MBTI字母或职业匹配率。
paragraphs.en: Highest means only greater than the other three counts in this attempt. A one-count lead and a larger lead cannot be directly interpreted as type stability. No near-tie blended-type threshold, MBTI conversion or career-match percentage has been established.

title.zh: 可以发挥的作用
title.en: A possible contribution

paragraphs.zh: 当大家已经同意目标、却迟迟没有行动时，提出一个可撤回的小步骤可能减少等待。前提是你确实有决策权限，也给受影响的人留下表达条件的机会。
paragraphs.en: When a goal is agreed but action stalls, a small reversible step may reduce waiting. This depends on having the authority to decide and allowing affected people to state their conditions.

title.zh: 过度使用时的代价
title.en: When the approach is overused

paragraphs.zh: 速度变成唯一标准时，尚未说出的顾虑可能被当作默认同意。观察的重点不是“我是不是太强势”，而是谁还没有发言、哪些后果尚未检查，以及返工是否抵消了节省的时间。
paragraphs.en: When speed becomes the only criterion, unspoken concerns may be mistaken for agreement. Check who has not spoken, which consequences remain unchecked and whether rework cancels the time saved, rather than assigning yourself a harsh label.

title.zh: 放进一个日常场景
title.en: A situation to consider

paragraphs.zh: 例如筹备一次朋友聚会，你可以先提两个时间和一个预算，请大家确认。若有人还不知道能否出席，就把时间标为暂定；一个便于行动的提案与替所有人作决定，有这一步之差。
paragraphs.en: For a gathering, propose two dates and a budget, then ask for confirmation. If someone cannot yet confirm availability, mark the date provisional. That separates a workable proposal from deciding for everyone.

title.zh: 可以直接使用的沟通句
title.en: Words to try in a conversation

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“我有一个先试的小方案。在决定之前，你最担心哪一步？什么情况需要暂停？”对方需要倾诉时，先问希望你听一听还是一起想办法，再使用解决问题的节奏。
paragraphs.en: Try: “I have a small proposal we could test. Before deciding, which step concerns you, and when should we pause?” If someone is sharing a difficulty, ask whether they want listening or joint problem-solving before offering a plan.

title.zh: 本周做一次小尝试
title.en: One small experiment this week

paragraphs.zh: 本周选一次低风险讨论，在提方案前邀请一位尚未发言的人说出条件。记下原方案、听到的信息和最后改动；回看有没有减少返工。只做一次就可以，不用强迫自己每次都放慢。
paragraphs.en: In one low-risk discussion this week, invite someone who has not spoken to state a condition before proposing your plan. Note the initial plan, new information and final change, then review whether rework decreased. One trial is enough.

title.zh: 与相近方向怎样区分
title.en: Distinguishing related directions

paragraphs.zh: D与C都可能提出明确要求，但本版D选项侧重启动与推进，C侧重标准与核对；D与I都可能主动开口，I更侧重表达与带动。行为外表相似时，回看当时在解决什么问题，比凭语气分型更有用。
paragraphs.en: D and C may both make clear requests; here D options emphasise initiating and advancing, while C emphasises standards and checks. D and I may both speak first, but I emphasises expression and engagement. Review the problem being addressed rather than typing someone from tone.

title.zh: 怎样判断这段解读是否适用
title.en: Check the reading against experience

paragraphs.zh: 挑一件最近发生、自己愿意回顾的小事，写下当时的目标、限制、实际做法和结果，再找一个没有采用这种做法的反例。若描述不合适，可以保留不认同；不需要把经历改写成符合标签的故事。上面的场景是编辑举例，不能从所选选项反推出你真实做过什么。
paragraphs.en: Choose a recent, ordinary event you are comfortable reviewing. Note the goal, constraints, action and outcome, then find a counterexample where you used another approach. You may reject a description that does not fit. The situations above are editorial examples; selected options cannot establish what you actually did.

title.zh: 愿意分享时，可以这样介绍
title.en: A way to introduce the result if you want to share

paragraphs.zh: “我这次DISC原始选择中，D·推进处理次数最高。我想观察它在具体事情中是否符合，也欢迎你说一个不同的例子。”只分享自己愿意公开的部分；这段话是可自行复制的表达示例，不会自动发布任何成绩。
paragraphs.en: “In this DISC attempt, D · Moving things forward had the highest count. I want to check how this fits particular situations, and would welcome a different example.” Share only what you choose to make public. This is wording you can copy yourself; it does not publish a score automatically.

paragraphs.zh: 朋友结果不同时，可以比较同一情境下各自需要什么；结果相同时，也可以找出做法不同的地方。任何组合都不能证明关系匹配、谁更适合负责，或谁必须迁就谁。公开结果链接展示通用解读，不包含你的个人计数或答案。
paragraphs.en: If a friend has a different result, compare what each of you needs in the same situation. If the result is the same, look for differences in action. No combination establishes compatibility, responsibility or who must accommodate whom. A public result link shows a general reading without your personal counts or answers.

title.zh: 方法与解释范围
title.en: Method and interpretation scope

paragraphs.zh: 本版为费马原创24题二选一问卷，尚未建立信度、效度、常模或跨语言等值。每个选项只在它与另一选项配对的条件下被选择；低计数可能表示相比之下更常选择另一做法，不能解释为绝对不喜欢或不会。
paragraphs.en: This is FermatMind’s original 24-item paired-choice questionnaire, without established reliability, validity, population norms or cross-language equivalence. Each option is chosen against its paired alternative; a lower count can reflect choosing the alternative more often, rather than an absolute dislike or inability.

paragraphs.zh: DISC有不同题本与报告系统。Everything DiSC官方说明包含12种风格，本版15份报告来自4个单项最高和11种最高并列组合，数量相近不表示模型相同。该官方来源仅用于辨别版本，不为本题本提供效度或认证。这里的建议是可选择的日常观察练习，不是诊断、招聘筛选或关系预测。
paragraphs.en: DISC has different instruments and report systems. Everything DiSC describes 12 styles; this edition’s 15 reports come from 4 single-highest outcomes and 11 highest-tie combinations. They are not equivalent models. The official source helps distinguish editions and does not validate or certify this questionnaire. Suggestions here are optional everyday observations, without diagnostic, hiring or relationship-prediction authority.

headline.zh: 四项相同，先回到具体选择
headline.en: With four equal counts, return to specific choices

scoreReading.en: Each question gives only the selected direction 1 count. D / I / S / C all have the same count and share the lead in this attempt. The system keeps the full tie rather than breaking it by question number, letter or option position.

title.zh: 先读清这次计数
title.en: Read the counts before the description

paragraphs.zh: 24题每题在两个方向中选一项，所选方向加1；四个计数合计24，每个方向有12次被选机会。次数比较的是本题组中的相对选择，不是能力、人格浓度或人群百分位。较少选择也不表示缺少某种品质。
paragraphs.en: Across 24 paired questions, each selection adds 1 to one direction. The four counts sum to 24, and each direction has 12 opportunities to be selected. Counts compare choices within this question set, rather than ability, personality concentration or population percentile. Fewer selections do not establish an absent quality.

paragraphs.zh: 所有最高并列完整保留；两项、三项、四项并列都不按题号或字母顺序选主型。四项并列时，每项必为6。相同计数并不说明两种做法同样熟练，也不能证明你能灵活切换。
paragraphs.en: Every highest tie is retained. Two-, three- and four-way ties do not acquire a primary type from question or letter order. In a four-way tie each count must be 6. Equal counts do not demonstrate equal skill or flexible switching.

title.zh: 逐项核对，不合成新人格
title.en: Review the directions separately

paragraphs.zh: D·推进处理：这次是否需要先定一个可撤回的下一步？这是回顾情境的问题，不是由并列计数推定的能力。
paragraphs.en: D · Moving things forward: Does this situation need a reversible next step first? This is a question for reviewing a situation, not an ability inferred from tied counts.

paragraphs.zh: I·表达带动：是否需要先把想法说清楚，让别人有机会回应？这是回顾情境的问题，不是由并列计数推定的能力。
paragraphs.en: I · Engaging through expression: Does the idea need explaining so others can respond? This is a question for reviewing a situation, not an ability inferred from tied counts.

paragraphs.zh: S·稳定支持：安排是否符合彼此能持续承担的节奏？这是回顾情境的问题，不是由并列计数推定的能力。
paragraphs.en: S · Steady support: Does the arrangement fit a pace both people can sustain? This is a question for reviewing a situation, not an ability inferred from tied counts.

paragraphs.zh: C·规范核对：哪些依据或完成条件需要先核对？这是回顾情境的问题，不是由并列计数推定的能力。
paragraphs.en: C · Standards and checks: Which evidence or completion criteria need checking first? This is a question for reviewing a situation, not an ability inferred from tied counts.

title.zh: 用具体情境理解并列
title.en: Understanding the tie in a situation

paragraphs.zh: 同一次活动里，你可能在定时间时想推进、聊创意时想表达、分工时想照顾节奏、核对费用时想查清楚。这里只是可核对的例子。
paragraphs.en: In one activity, setting a time might call for action, ideas for expression, task sharing for support and expenses for checking. These are examples to compare with experience.

title.zh: 可能的拉扯与误读
title.en: Possible tensions and misreadings

paragraphs.zh: 四项相同既不证明全能、平衡或适应性强，也不证明没有个性；它只说明本次四个计数相等。
paragraphs.en: Equal counts do not establish versatility, balance or adaptability, or a lack of individuality. They only record four equal counts in this attempt.

title.zh: 本周做一次小尝试
title.en: One small experiment this week

paragraphs.zh: 选一题回想具体经历，记录当时两个选项为何难取舍；无需为了得到单一字母重测。
paragraphs.en: Choose one question and recall a specific experience, noting why its two options were difficult to choose between. There is no need to retake just to obtain one letter.

title.zh: 把并列结果变成一次对话
title.en: Turn the tie into a conversation

paragraphs.zh: 可以说：“这次D·推进处理、I·表达带动、S·稳定支持、C·规范核对的计数并列最高。我们先分别看看：这次是否需要先定一个可撤回的下一步？是否需要先把想法说清楚，让别人有机会回应？安排是否符合彼此能持续承担的节奏？哪些依据或完成条件需要先核对？哪一问最符合这件事？”请对方举一个符合或不符合的例子，而不是为你选主型。
paragraphs.en: Try: “D · Moving things forward / I · Engaging through expression / S · Steady support / C · Standards and checks tied for the highest count in this attempt. Let us consider these questions separately: Does this situation need a reversible next step first? Does the idea need explaining so others can respond? Does the arrangement fit a pace both people can sustain? Which evidence or completion criteria need checking first? Which matters most here?” Invite an example that fits or does not fit, rather than asking someone to assign your primary type.

title.zh: 怎样判断这段解读是否适用
title.en: Check the reading against experience

paragraphs.zh: 挑一件最近发生、自己愿意回顾的小事，写下当时的目标、限制、实际做法和结果，再找一个没有采用这种做法的反例。若描述不合适，可以保留不认同；不需要把经历改写成符合标签的故事。上面的场景是编辑举例，不能从所选选项反推出你真实做过什么。
paragraphs.en: Choose a recent, ordinary event you are comfortable reviewing. Note the goal, constraints, action and outcome, then find a counterexample where you used another approach. You may reject a description that does not fit. The situations above are editorial examples; selected options cannot establish what you actually did.

title.zh: 愿意分享时，可以这样介绍
title.en: A way to introduce the result if you want to share

paragraphs.zh: “我这次DISC原始选择中，D·推进处理、I·表达带动、S·稳定支持、C·规范核对并列最高。我想观察它在具体事情中是否符合，也欢迎你说一个不同的例子。”只分享自己愿意公开的部分；这段话是可自行复制的表达示例，不会自动发布任何成绩。
paragraphs.en: “In this DISC attempt, D · Moving things forward / I · Engaging through expression / S · Steady support / C · Standards and checks tied for the highest count. I want to check how this fits particular situations, and would welcome a different example.” Share only what you choose to make public. This is wording you can copy yourself; it does not publish a score automatically.

paragraphs.zh: 朋友结果不同时，可以比较同一情境下各自需要什么；结果相同时，也可以找出做法不同的地方。任何组合都不能证明关系匹配、谁更适合负责，或谁必须迁就谁。公开结果链接展示通用解读，不包含你的个人计数或答案。
paragraphs.en: If a friend has a different result, compare what each of you needs in the same situation. If the result is the same, look for differences in action. No combination establishes compatibility, responsibility or who must accommodate whom. A public result link shows a general reading without your personal counts or answers.

title.zh: 方法与解释范围
title.en: Method and interpretation scope

paragraphs.zh: 本版为费马原创24题二选一问卷，尚未建立信度、效度、常模或跨语言等值。每个选项只在它与另一选项配对的条件下被选择；低计数可能表示相比之下更常选择另一做法，不能解释为绝对不喜欢或不会。
paragraphs.en: This is FermatMind’s original 24-item paired-choice questionnaire, without established reliability, validity, population norms or cross-language equivalence. Each option is chosen against its paired alternative; a lower count can reflect choosing the alternative more often, rather than an absolute dislike or inability.

paragraphs.zh: DISC有不同题本与报告系统。Everything DiSC官方说明包含12种风格，本版15份报告来自4个单项最高和11种最高并列组合，数量相近不表示模型相同。该官方来源仅用于辨别版本，不为本题本提供效度或认证。这里的建议是可选择的日常观察练习，不是诊断、招聘筛选或关系预测。
paragraphs.en: DISC has different instruments and report systems. Everything DiSC describes 12 styles; this edition’s 15 reports come from 4 single-highest outcomes and 11 highest-tie combinations. They are not equivalent models. The official source helps distinguish editions and does not validate or certify this questionnaire. Suggestions here are optional everyday observations, without diagnostic, hiring or relationship-prediction authority.

description.zh: DISC D/I/S/C四项次数完全相同时，不指定领先方向。阅读完整并列说明、具体情境、计分局限和下一步；这不是全能、完美平衡或测试失败的证明。

title.zh: 版本比较来源：Everything DiSC官方模型说明
title.en: Edition comparison source: Everything DiSC’s official model explanation

title.zh: 怎样阅读DISC结果：计数、解释与行为例证
title.en: Reading DISC results: counts, explanations and behavioral examples

paragraphs.zh: 先查看四个方向的原始计数，再阅读所有最高计数对应的单项或并列指南。计数回答“在这组二选一中更常选择哪类做法”；解释提供核对行为的语言。两者都需要回到具体情境，而不能只保留一个字母标签。
paragraphs.en: Start with all four raw counts, then read the guide for the single direction or full set of directions sharing the highest count. Counts answer which responses you selected more often in these paired choices; explanations provide language for checking behaviors. Bring both back to situations rather than keeping only a letter label.

paragraphs.zh: 例如，D与C同时较常被选中，可以回看自己是否既重视行动推进，也重视依据与标准；再找出一件符合、另一件不符合的近期经历。这个例子用于提出观察问题，不代表已发现两种稳定特质或某种“最佳组合”。
paragraphs.en: For example, when D and C are both selected relatively often, consider whether you attend to both forward action and evidence or standards. Find one recent event that fits and another that does not. This example generates an observation question; it does not establish two stable traits or a “best combination.”

title.zh: 24题的配对结构与计分公式
title.en: The 24-item comparison design and counting rule

paragraphs.zh: 四个方向共有6种两两配对，每种配对出现4次，共24题。每题只选一项，所选方向记1次，其余方向不加分。因此每个方向参与12次比较，单项计数范围为0—12，完成后四项计数合计始终为24。
paragraphs.en: There are six distinct pairs among the four directions. Each pair appears four times, giving 24 questions. Each answer adds one count only to the selected direction. Every direction therefore participates in 12 comparisons, each count ranges from 0 to 12, and the four completed counts always sum to 24.

paragraphs.zh: 可将某方向的计数写为：W(d)＝ΣI（第q题选中的方向为d），q取1至24；条件成立时I＝1，否则I＝0。结果取所有达到最大W值的方向，并按这组方向显示对应报告。计分使用实际答案，既不随机分配结果，也不按选项位置或字母顺序破同分。
paragraphs.en: For direction d, W(d) = ΣI(the direction selected on question q is d), with q running from 1 to 24. The indicator I is 1 when the condition holds and 0 otherwise. The result contains every direction attaining the maximum W, and the report corresponds to that set. Scoring uses actual answers, with no random assignment or tie-break based on option position or letter order.

paragraphs.zh: 本题本的四项计数受固定总数约束：多选择一个方向，会相应减少另一个方向被选中的机会。这是题组内的相对比较。即使把次数除以12，也只能得到该方向在本次比较中的被选比例，不能据此得到人群百分位、能力水平或测试准确率。
paragraphs.en: The fixed total constrains the four counts: selecting one direction means passing over another. This is a relative comparison within the question set. Even dividing a count by 12 gives only its selection rate in these comparisons, not a population percentile, ability level or test accuracy.

title.zh: 最高并列、近分与计分示例
title.en: Highest-count ties, nearby counts and a scoring example

paragraphs.zh: 假设一份完整作答得到D＝8、I＝8、S＝4、C＝4，则最高值为8，显示D／I并列报告。S与C虽然同为4，但不是最高计数，不进入顶部并列。若四项均为6，则显示四方向并列；所有最高并列都完整保留。以上为演示数据，不是某位用户的结果。
paragraphs.en: Suppose a completed attempt gives D = 8, I = 8, S = 4 and C = 4. The maximum is 8, so the D/I tied report is shown. S and C are equal but are not highest, so they do not join the top tie. If all four counts are 6, the four-direction tied report is shown. These are demonstration values, not a user’s result.

paragraphs.zh: 四个方向的非空最高组合共15种：4种单项、6种双方向并列、4种三方向并列和1种四方向并列。这里的15种是报告覆盖范围，不是另一个“15型人格”理论，也不新增独立分数。
paragraphs.en: The four directions have 15 nonempty possible leader sets: four singles, six two-direction ties, four three-direction ties and one four-direction tie. These are report categories, not a separate theory of 15 personality types or additional scores.

paragraphs.zh: 本版本没有设置近分合并阈值。相差1次表示这次选择次数相差1次；由于尚无本题本的测量误差估计，不能将它解释为显著的心理差异。可以同时阅读相近方向，但系统只把实际相同的最高计数显示为并列。
paragraphs.en: This edition has no near-score merging threshold. A difference of one means one selected response; without measurement-error estimates for this questionnaire, it cannot be interpreted as a statistically meaningful psychological difference. You may read nearby directions together, but the system marks only exactly equal highest counts as tied.

title.zh: 以同一情境参照理解自报结果
title.en: Use a consistent context when interpreting self-report

paragraphs.zh: 自报问卷记录的是你对自身行为的判断。工作职责、合作对象、近期压力、题目理解与理想化作答都可能影响选择。建议先选定“近期较常见的协作情境”，再用同一参照完成整份问卷；不要在不同题目之间不断切换成不同角色。
paragraphs.en: A self-report records your judgments about your own behavior. Responsibilities, collaborators, recent pressure, item interpretation and idealized responding can all affect choices. Pick a reference such as typical recent collaboration and keep it consistent across the questionnaire rather than switching roles from item to item.

paragraphs.zh: 重复作答时，先比较使用的版本、间隔时间、作答情境和四项计数，再看字母是否变化。一次计数变化可能来自经历变化或作答波动；仅凭两次结果不能区分这些原因，也不能断言人格已经改变。
paragraphs.en: For a repeat attempt, compare the version, time interval, context and four counts before comparing letters. A changed count may reflect changed experience or variation in responding. Two attempts alone cannot distinguish these causes or demonstrate a personality change.

title.zh: 较低计数反映相对选择
title.en: Lower counts describe relative selections

paragraphs.zh: 较低计数意味着：在该方向参与的12次比较中，你相对较少选择这一类做法。它不表示相应行为完全不存在，也不等于能力不足。例如，较少选择“先核对标准”，仍可能在实际工作中按要求完成质量检查。
paragraphs.en: A lower count means you selected that response direction less often in its 12 comparisons. It does not mean the behavior is absent or an ability is deficient. Someone who less often chooses to check standards first may still perform required quality checks at work.

title.zh: 四个方向的含义与相邻概念
title.en: What the four directions mean

paragraphs.zh: D·推进处理（Dominance）：关注目标、决断与行动推进。本题本借由先定下一步、处理障碍等选择观察这一方向，讨论的是行动侧重，不是领导能力或支配他人的资格。
paragraphs.en: D · Moving things forward (Dominance): attention to goals, decisions and forward action. Choices about defining next steps or addressing obstacles represent this direction here. It describes an action emphasis, not leadership ability or entitlement to control others.

paragraphs.zh: I·表达带动（Influence）：关注表达、互动与共同参与。相关选择涉及先开启讨论、传达想法或带动交流；被选次数不等于实际影响力、受欢迎程度或外向性常模分数。
paragraphs.en: I · Engaging through expression (Influence): attention to expression, interaction and shared participation. Relevant choices involve opening discussion, communicating ideas or engaging others. Counts are not actual persuasive success, popularity or a normed extraversion score.

paragraphs.zh: S·稳定支持（Steadiness）：关注持续协作、节奏与支持。相关选择涉及照顾交接、稳定安排和回应合作需要；这是一类情境中的行为取向，不是对可靠程度或心理稳定性的认证。
paragraphs.en: S · Steady support (Steadiness): attention to continuity, pace and support in cooperation. Relevant choices involve handoffs, stable arrangements and collaborators’ needs. This is a response emphasis, not a certification of reliability or emotional stability.

paragraphs.zh: C·规范核对（Conscientiousness）：关注依据、细节与标准。相关选择涉及澄清规则、核实信息或检查条件；字母相同并不意味着它等于大五人格的尽责性分数，也不能由此推算其他测评结果。
paragraphs.en: C · Standards and checks (Conscientiousness): attention to evidence, details and standards. Relevant choices involve clarifying rules, verifying information or checking conditions. Sharing an English term does not make this count equivalent to a Big Five conscientiousness score or allow conversion into another assessment.

paragraphs.zh: 四个字母在不同DISC产品中的名称、题目和解释并不完全一致。本页使用上述费马方向名称阅读实际作答；通用四风格及其历史背景可参照文献[1]，不将其他产品的剖面图或分型阈值套入本站计数。
paragraphs.en: Names, items and interpretations vary across DISC products. Use the FermatMind direction labels above to read this attempt. Reference [1] provides background on the four-style framework; other products’ profile charts and cutoffs are not applied to these counts.

title.zh: 适用读者与结果的使用目标
title.en: Who this questionnaire is for

paragraphs.zh: 本页适合能够结合工作、学习或小组合作经历作答、希望整理自身沟通与行动习惯的读者。可以独立阅读，也可以在自愿分享的前提下，用行为例子讨论合作需求，例如怎样提出建议、安排交接或确认任务标准。
paragraphs.en: This page is for readers able to draw on work, study or group-collaboration experiences who want to organize observations about communication and action. Read it privately, or voluntarily share behavioral examples to discuss needs such as proposing ideas, arranging handoffs or clarifying task standards.

paragraphs.zh: 本问卷不评估心理症状，也没有临床诊断阈值。若问题涉及健康、学习困难或持续影响生活的情绪与行为，应使用适合该问题的专业评估途径，而不是用DISC字母代替判断。
paragraphs.en: This questionnaire does not assess symptoms and has no clinical diagnostic thresholds. Questions about health, learning difficulties or emotions and behaviors affecting daily life need an appropriate assessment route rather than a DISC letter.

title.zh: 模型来源与费马实现
title.en: The model and the FermatMind implementation

paragraphs.zh: Marston的理论背景、后续商业DISC产品和本页问卷是三个不同层次。本站24题、六组配对、计数规则与报告均来自费马自有题本和实现；未使用Wiley Everything DiSC的自适应题本、八量尺或圆环定位算法，也不提供其认证报告。[1]
paragraphs.en: Marston’s theoretical background, later commercial DISC products and this questionnaire are distinct levels. These 24 items, six paired comparisons, count rules and reports belong to FermatMind’s own questionnaire and implementation. They do not use Wiley Everything DiSC’s adaptive item bank, eight scales or circular placement algorithm, and do not provide its certified report.[1]

title.zh: 把结果转化为可核对的沟通行动
title.en: Turn a result into an observable communication experiment

paragraphs.zh: 选一个近期情境，按“发生了什么—我先做了什么—对方需要什么—下次怎样调整”记录。比如会议中自己倾向先推进决定，可以尝试在结束前再核对一次未表达的意见与验收标准，再观察沟通是否更清楚。这是自选尝试，不是根据类型给出的固定处方。
paragraphs.en: Choose a recent event and record what happened, what you did first, what others needed and what you might change next time. If you tended to push for a decision in a meeting, you could check once more for unspoken views and acceptance criteria before closing it. Observe whether communication becomes clearer. This is an optional experiment, not a type-based prescription.

paragraphs.zh: 招聘、晋升、绩效评价和职业选择需要与其用途相匹配的证据。本题本尚未建立相关效标证据，不能据计数筛选人员、推断领导力或承诺岗位匹配。兴趣、技能、价值观、任务表现与现实条件应分别调查。
paragraphs.en: Hiring, promotion, performance evaluation and career choice require evidence appropriate to those decisions. This questionnaire has no established criterion evidence for them. Do not use its counts to select people, infer leadership ability or promise job fit. Investigate interests, skills, values, task performance and practical conditions separately.

title.zh: DISC科学性：怎样看待研究与本站证据
title.en: DISC research: what is and is not established here

paragraphs.zh: 评价心理测量工具时，需要分别核对题本、语言、人群、计分与用途。信度关注结果的一致性，效度关注对结果的特定解释和使用是否有证据，常模则提供特定参照人群的分布。算法可复算，只能证明计数规则明确，不能单独证明这些测量属性。
paragraphs.en: Evaluate the questionnaire, language, population, scoring and intended use separately. Reliability concerns consistency; validity concerns evidence for a particular interpretation and use; norms describe a reference population’s distribution. A reproducible algorithm demonstrates a clear counting rule, not those measurement properties by itself.

paragraphs.zh: Wiley的研究报告讨论其Everything DiSC工具的信度与效度；这些证据只支持对应产品、版本及研究条件，不验证费马24题。[1] Martinussen、Richardsen与Vårum对103名大学生开展的DISCUS研究发现，其自比式与常模式版本并不等价；这是对该工具及样本的研究，提示不能因名称相近就直接换算或共享效度结论。[2]
paragraphs.en: Wiley’s report evaluates its Everything DiSC instrument; its findings concern that product, edition and study conditions, not FermatMind’s 24 items.[1] In a study of 103 undergraduates, Martinussen, Richardsen and Vårum found that ipsative and normative DISCUS versions were not equivalent. This finding concerns that instrument and sample, and cautions against assuming interchangeable scores or validity evidence merely from similar names.[2]

paragraphs.zh: 费马本题本尚未建立内部一致性、重测信度、结构效度、效标关联及中文参照常模。因此本站呈现原始次数与完整读法，定位为娱乐和日常自我探索；不宣称“全球公认最准确”、测出固定人格本质或优于其他量表。未来若要支持更强用途，需要在明确目标人群与预定分析方法下另行研究。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind has not established internal consistency, test–retest reliability, structural validity, criterion relationships or Chinese population norms for these items. The present output is raw counts and complete interpretation for entertainment and everyday self-exploration. It makes no claim of being the most accurate test worldwide, identifying a fixed personality essence or outperforming other measures. Stronger uses would require research in a defined target population using prespecified methods.

title.zh: 泰国四种动物测试：为什么需要区分来源
title.en: Thai Four Animals: why the source matters

paragraphs.zh: “泰国四种动物”是对行为风格的动物化命名，在所核对的两份公开材料中，D/I/S/C并没有完全相同的动物对应：JobCannon使用牛、鹰、熊、鼠；教师本人2021年发表的Inskru课堂活动依次使用牛、鹰、鼠、熊。[3] 这两个例子证明存在S/C映射差异，不能据此认定唯一标准或推断这一命名传统的历史起源。
paragraphs.en: The two checked public accounts of Thai Four Animals do not assign identical animal names to D/I/S/C. JobCannon uses Bull, Eagle, Bear and Mouse; a teacher’s 2021 Inskru classroom activity uses Bull, Eagle, Mouse and Bear, respectively.[3] These examples establish an S/C naming difference, not a single standard or a historical origin for the tradition.

paragraphs.zh: 比较动物结果时，应同时核对来源、字母和计分方式。例如，一个版本中的“熊”可能是S，另一个版本中的“熊”却是C。本站完整报告同时列出两套标签，帮助辨认命名差异；动物意象本身不构成独立的测量证据。
paragraphs.en: When comparing animal results, check the source, letter and scoring method together. Bear may mean S in one version and C in another. The complete reports show both sets of labels so readers can distinguish the naming conventions. An animal metaphor supplies no independent measurement evidence.

title.zh: 同一份作答，怎样产生动物标签
title.en: How the same answers produce animal labels

paragraphs.zh: 本站只施测一次24题DISC式问卷，保留四项次数和所有最高并列，再在对应说明中显示来源明确的动物标签。没有第二套动物题本、独立动物分数或主次动物排名；动物标签也不是人格百分比。
paragraphs.en: Only one 24-item DISC-style questionnaire is administered. Its four counts and every highest-count tie are retained, and the relevant explanation shows source-specific animal labels. There is no second animal questionnaire, separate animal score, primary/secondary animal ranking or percentage of personality.

paragraphs.zh: 结果指南中的行为说明与计分保持原有来源和规则；动物名称只是对同一组方向作补充阅读。本站题数与规则不同于JobCannon的12题版，两个产品的分数和报告不应直接换算。
paragraphs.en: Behavioral explanations and scoring in the result guides keep their original source and rules. Animal names provide an additional way to read the same direction set. This questionnaire differs from JobCannon’s 12-item form; the two products’ scores and reports should not be converted directly.

paragraphs.zh: Inskru课堂材料将C写为Compliance；本题本方向代码使用Conscientiousness，中文为“规范核对”。这里比较的是命名方式，不认定不同题本的内容、分数或心理测量属性等值，也不把该C转换为大五人格的尽责性分数。
paragraphs.en: The Inskru classroom material calls C Compliance; this questionnaire’s direction code uses Conscientiousness, labeled standards and checks. This is a comparison of names, not evidence of equivalent items, scores or psychometric properties across instruments, and it does not convert C into Big Five conscientiousness.

question.zh: DISC测试是什么，D、I、S、C各代表什么？
question.en: What is a DISC test, and what do D, I, S and C mean?

answer.zh: DISC是一组行为风格框架。D（Dominance）关注推进与行动，I（Influence）关注表达与互动，S（Steadiness）关注持续支持，C（Conscientiousness）关注依据与标准。本页以费马24题的实际选择次数描述这些方向；四个字母不能覆盖全部人格，也不直接对应能力高低。[1]
answer.en: DISC is a family of behavioral-style frameworks. D (Dominance) emphasizes action, I (Influence) expression and interaction, S (Steadiness) ongoing support, and C (Conscientiousness) evidence and standards. This page describes those directions through choices in FermatMind’s 24 items. The letters do not encompass all personality or rank ability.[1]

question.zh: 这份DISC测试科学吗？与官方商业量表有什么区别？
question.en: Is this DISC test scientifically validated or an official commercial assessment?

answer.zh: DISC模型有不同产品和研究。本页是费马原创自报问卷，尚未建立本题本的信度、效度与常模；Wiley等产品的验证结果不能直接套用。本站的透明计分适合复算本次选择，不等于已完成心理测量学验证，也不是商业DISC认证报告。[1][2]
answer.en: DISC has multiple products and research programs. This is FermatMind’s original self-report; reliability, validity and norms have not been established for it. Findings for products such as Wiley’s cannot be transferred directly. Transparent scoring makes these choices reproducible but does not establish psychometric validity or provide a commercial DISC certification.[1][2]

question.zh: 为什么有的平台讲4型、12型或16型，这里却有15种结果？
question.en: Why do some DISC products describe 4, 12 or 16 styles, while this test has 15 outcomes?

answer.zh: 四个字母是框架方向，报告分类取决于具体产品的题型与计分设计。例如，Wiley Everything DiSC使用环形模型解释12个风格区域；其他产品可能采用不同的组合或命名。[1] 本站15种结果只枚举“哪些方向同为最高”：4种单项、6种双项、4种三项及1种四项并列。D / I并列不区分D优先或I优先，也不是把所有人的行为分成15个固定人格类型。跨平台阅读时，应先核对题本、尺度与分类规则，不能仅凭相同字母认定结果等价。
answer.en: The four letters name model directions; report categories depend on a specific instrument and its scoring design. For example, Wiley Everything DiSC interprets 12 style regions in a circumplex model, while other products use different combinations or labels.[1] This test enumerates only which directions share the highest count: four single leaders, six pairs, four triples and one four-way tie. A D / I tie has no D-first or I-first order and does not classify everyone into 15 fixed personality types. Check the instrument, scales and classification rules before comparing products.

question.zh: DISC测试要多久，是否免费、需要注册吗？
question.en: How long does it take, and are questions and full results free?

answer.zh: 共24道工作情境二选一，预计约5分钟，实际用时因阅读与思考速度而异。全部题目、四项计数和15种结果指南免费，无需注册或先完成MBTI。约5分钟是阅读作答估计，不是倒计时限制。
answer.en: There are 24 paired work-situation choices, with an estimated completion time of about five minutes depending on reading and reflection. All items, four counts and 15 result guides are free, with no signup or prerequisite MBTI test. Five minutes is an estimate, not a countdown limit.

question.zh: 为什么会出现两个、三个或四个并列方向？
question.en: Why can two, three or all four directions tie?

answer.zh: 每道题给选中的方向记1次。结果保留达到相同最高次数的所有方向。例如D＝8、I＝8、S＝4、C＝4对应D／I并列。并列不是错误，不按字母、题号或随机规则强分先后；相近但不相等的次数不会自动合并。
answer.en: Each choice adds one count to its direction. The result retains every direction sharing the highest count. For example, D = 8, I = 8, S = 4 and C = 4 gives a D/I tie. A tie is not an error and is not broken by letter order, question order or randomness. Nearby but unequal counts are not merged.

question.zh: 四个方向能同时很高或很低吗？四项并列意味着什么？
question.en: Can all four counts be high or low? What does a four-way tie mean?

answer.zh: 在本站24题中，每题只给所选方向加1次，因此四项合计恒为24；每个方向参与12次比较，范围为0—12。四项不可能同时为12，也不可能同时为0。四项完全并列只能是D = I = S = C = 6。这表示本题组中的选择次数相等，不能推导为四种能力均衡、人格完整或更擅长适应。某项为0也只表示在它参与的12次比较中都选择了另一项。
answer.en: Each of the 24 items adds one choice to one direction, so the four counts always sum to 24. Each direction appears in 12 comparisons and ranges from 0 to 12. All four cannot be 12 or zero. A four-way tie is necessarily D = I = S = C = 6: equal choice counts in this item set, not evidence of balanced abilities, a complete personality or superior adaptability. A zero means only that the alternative was chosen in each of that direction’s 12 comparisons.

question.zh: 分数能看出我超过多少人，或者哪项能力更强吗？
question.en: Do counts show a percentile or stronger abilities?

answer.zh: 不能。本题本比较的是同一人对配对选项的相对选择，四项总数固定为24。单项0—12是计数范围，不是常模分数；缺少参照样本与相关效度证据，无法换算人群百分位、能力等级或招聘通过线。
answer.en: No. The questionnaire compares the same person’s selections between paired responses, with a fixed total of 24. A 0–12 count range is not a normed score. Without a reference sample and relevant validity evidence, it cannot yield a population percentile, ability level or hiring cutoff.

question.zh: 这份问卷会分别测出“自然风格”和“适应风格”吗？
question.en: Does this questionnaire separately measure natural and adapted styles?

answer.zh: 不会。部分商业产品分别提供自然与适应风格图，但这依赖其专门的作答指令与计分方法。本站只要求围绕近期常见的工作、学习或协作情境作答，生成一组D、I、S、C原始次数，不另行计算自然、适应、压力或理想风格。若在不同情境重测，差异可作为反思材料；没有相应验证数据时，不能把差值解释为适应成本、压力强度或真实人格与外在表现的距离。
answer.en: No. Some commercial instruments provide separate natural and adapted graphs using their own instructions and scoring procedures. This questionnaire asks about a typical recent work, study or collaboration context and generates one set of D, I, S and C counts. It does not separately score natural, adapted, stress or ideal styles. Retesting in another context may prompt reflection, but without supporting validation data a difference cannot quantify adaptation cost, stress or a gap between a true personality and outward behavior.

question.zh: 答案在哪里计算，是否会保存？
question.en: Where are answers calculated, and can I save progress?

answer.zh: 答案在当前浏览器内计分，不随计分请求上传服务器，也不写入网址或分析事件。默认不保存作答；主动勾选临时保存后，本标签页可在24小时内恢复，完成、退出清除或重测会删除进度。网站可能记录不含答案的开始、完成等使用事件，具体以隐私与Cookie设置为准。
answer.en: Answers are scored in the current browser, not uploaded for scoring or placed in URLs or analytics events. Attempts are not saved by default. Opt-in tab saving permits resumption within 24 hours and clears on completion, exit-and-clear or retake. The website may record answer-free start or completion events subject to privacy and cookie settings.

question.zh: DISC和MBTI、大五人格有什么区别，可以换算吗？
question.en: How does DISC differ from MBTI and the Big Five, and can scores be converted?

answer.zh: 本页DISC关注工作情境中的四类行为选择；MBTI围绕四组偏好组织类型，大五人格用五个连续领域描述特质。它们的概念、题目、计分和参照不同。仅凭某个DISC字母不能推出MBTI类型或大五分数；DISCUS研究中观察到的相关也不等于个人结果可以换算。[2]
answer.en: This DISC page concerns four work-situation response directions. MBTI organizes types around four preference pairs; the Big Five describes traits in five continuous domains. Concepts, items, scores and reference groups differ. A DISC letter cannot determine an MBTI type or Big Five score; correlations reported in DISCUS research do not establish individual score conversion.[2]

question.zh: DISC结果可以用于职业选择或招聘筛选吗？
question.en: Can this result be used for career decisions or recruitment?

answer.zh: 可以把结果用于提出自我观察问题，例如“我通常怎样推进任务、核对标准或回应同伴”；不能据本站计数判断岗位适任性、录用、晋升或工作绩效。本题本尚无这些用途所需的效标证据。职业探索还需要调查兴趣、技能、价值观、岗位任务和实际体验。
answer.en: Use it to generate reflection questions such as how you usually advance tasks, check standards or respond to collaborators. Do not use these counts to judge job suitability, hiring, promotion or performance: this questionnaire lacks criterion evidence for those uses. Career exploration also needs interests, skills, values, job tasks and practical experience.

question.zh: 怎样把DISC结果用于一次具体的沟通，而不是贴标签？
question.en: How can I use a DISC result in a specific conversation without labeling someone?

answer.zh: 先选一件真实发生的事，而不是先猜对方的类型。例如交接延误时，可以分别核对下一步由谁推进、是否共同理解要求、时间安排是否可行、完成标准是否明确。把本次较常选的方向转成一个可观察的问题，再听取对方的实际需要，并尝试一项小调整。之后记录是否改善理解与交接；结果提供讨论入口，实际效果仍以行为和反馈核对，不依据字母替他人下结论。
answer.en: Start with a real event rather than guessing another person’s type. For a delayed handoff, check who owns the next action, whether requirements are understood, whether the schedule is workable and whether completion criteria are clear. Turn a frequently selected direction into an observable question, ask what the other person needs and try one small adjustment. Check subsequent behavior and feedback; the letters offer a discussion prompt, not a conclusion about someone else.

question.zh: 重测结果变化，代表行为风格改变了吗？
question.en: Does a different result on retesting mean my style has changed?

answer.zh: 不能仅凭字母变化下结论。接近最高值的计数稍有变动，就可能改变最高方向或并列组合。应先核对题本版本、参照情境和具体回答，再结合近期行为例证阅读；本站尚无重测信度与测量误差数据，不能量化“改变了多少”。
answer.en: A changed letter alone is insufficient evidence. Small count changes near the maximum can change the leading direction or tied set. Compare the questionnaire edition, context and responses, then consider recent behavioral examples. Without test–retest and measurement-error data for this edition, the amount of psychological change cannot be quantified.

question.zh: 这也算泰国四种动物测试吗？为什么熊和鼠会对应不同方向？
question.en: Is this a Thai Four Animals test, and why can Bear and Mouse switch directions?

answer.zh: 本站提供同一份DISC作答的动物标签对照，不另做动物问卷。所核对的JobCannon版本将S/C对应熊/鼠，Inskru教师2021年课堂版本则对应鼠/熊。[3] 所以应先看来源与字母，再看动物；两套标签同时出现在完整结果指南中，不产生额外分数。
answer.en: This page compares animal labels for the same DISC answers rather than administering another questionnaire. The checked JobCannon version maps S/C to Bear/Mouse, while the teacher’s 2021 Inskru version maps them to Mouse/Bear.[3] Check the source and letter before the animal. Both label sets appear in the full guides without additional scores.

title.en: Inskru · Teacher’s 2021 classroom activity: an example of Four Animals naming

title.en: JobCannon · Public Four Animals naming comparison: a separate 12-item product

instructions.zh: 请以近期较常见的工作、学习或合作经历为参照，每题选择更贴近自己通常做法的一项。两项都像时，比较哪项更经常、或更先出现；两项都不像时，选相对更贴近的一项。题目没有正确答案，不必按理想形象作答。完成全部24题后生成计数与完整结果。
instructions.en: Use recent, typical work, study or collaborative experiences as your reference. Choose the response closer to what you usually do. If both fit, consider which happens more often or first; if neither fits, choose the closer one. There are no correct answers, so avoid answering as an ideal version of yourself. Complete all 24 choices to generate counts and the full result.
